selected_openwebui_answer_path.why_selected: This path was recently proven to build page_context_pack_v3, call Gemma4 through Ollama /api/chat with visible message.content, pass page alignment, and return without fallback for a page-binder question.
known_limits: Needs existing Engram/Self-RAG/CRAG modules wired into its native answer path.
Must keep proof_context separate from guidance_only records.

status_definitions.active_current: Selected or directly required by the current 8023 OpenWebUI page-native answer path.
status_definitions.active_current_openwebui_path: The selected current OpenWebUI answer path.
status_definitions.active_support: Actively kept and intended for reuse/wiring, but not the selected endpoint itself.
status_definitions.active_support_to_wire: Known support module that must be wired into the selected endpoint in the next integration patch.
status_definitions.support_only_fastpath_or_legacy: May remain useful for deterministic/fast tasks or reference, but is not the primary current endpoint.
status_definitions.superseded_not_primary: Older answer/runtime path. Do not use as the current endpoint. Keep until current path passes integration/eval.
status_definitions.superseded_do_not_use_as_current_openweb: Known old endpoint that should not be pointed at OpenWebUI for current testing.
status_definitions.backup_snapshot: Patch/edit backup file. Never import. Candidate for quarantine only after integration tests and git safety checks.
status_definitions.archived_reference: Historical/reference material under docs/archive or old patch folders.
status_definitions.script_wrapper: Thin CLI entrypoint. Keep if it is used for running/checking an active module.

pipeline_stages.name: Question/page detection
pipeline_stages.contract: Detect page-explicit questions and route them to page_context_pack_v3.

pipeline_stages.name: Proof/guidance binder
pipeline_stages.contract: Build source-bounded binder with proof records, guidance records, route metadata, and safety counters.

pipeline_stages.name: Engram behavior overlay
pipeline_stages.contract: Retrieve policy/style/failure/example behavior memory. Engram is guidance only, not factual proof.

pipeline_stages.name: Native Gemma answer draft
pipeline_stages.contract: Call Ollama /api/chat with Gemma4, think:false, bounded context, and visible message.content.

pipeline_stages.name: Self-RAG critic
pipeline_stages.contract: Check proof-vs-guidance discipline, citation/page alignment, forbidden overclaims, and limits.

pipeline_stages.name: CRAG repair
pipeline_stages.contract: Repair only when critic requires repair; never invent proof or promote guidance to proof.

pipeline_stages.name: Final runtime gate
pipeline_stages.contract: Enforce zero source-truth mutation, no DB writes, no answer permission, and no unsupported claims.

pipeline_stages.name: OpenWebUI response
pipeline_stages.contract: Return answer, trace_net metadata, safety counters, and fallback when alignment/critic/gate fails.
